trace.question:
I haven't paid anything yet. You asked for Harbor Logistics's approved invoice, but it has two:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-18427 | $7,803.36 | approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-82192 | $4,381.98 | approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-31854 | $2,435.17 | draft (still needs approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-88522 | $4,190.51 | already paid | 2026-09-30 |

You want it paid exactly once, so I didn't want to guess which one you meant. A payment to the wrong invoice would have to be reversed. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither invoice has been paid.

Which should I pay: INV-18427, INV-82192 or both? Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available. I'll use an idempotency key so it only goes through once, then report the payment. Both amounts are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-82192, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-82192, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-82192 in full by wire from the operating account. It was sent once and the system confirmed it.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Vendor:** Harbor Logistics (V-620)
- **Invoice:** INV-82192, due 2026-11-25, now marked paid
- **Amount:** $4,381.98
- **Method:** Wire (ACH wasn't needed)

I attached an idempotency key, so if the request is repeated by accident it won't send a second payment. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't touch INV-18427 ($7,803.36) because it's under dispute, or INV-31854 ($2,435.17) because it's still a draft waiting for approval.
